create_sacred_ingredient: create a Sacred Ingredient to encapsulate dataset configuration and reusable functions
run_load_data: run the captured load_data function to load and optionally normalize a dataset
run_stats_command: run the stats command to print dataset statistics with configurable parameters
create_sacred_experiment: create a Sacred Experiment that incorporates an Ingredient for shared configuration
run_experiment_automain: run the automain experiment entry point that loads data and prints results
